mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% signals economic distress and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 financial crisis regime, a rise in the CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals recovery from deflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-2008 financial crisis regime despite rising CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 900,000 units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 900.0 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and stable or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or declining (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In the manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 (over a 5-year rolling window).
